name: Spondyloepiphyseal Dysplasia, Omani Type

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Radiological Diagnostic Criteria for Spondyloepiphyseal Dysplasia, Omani Type

criteria.description: Severe short stature with disproportionate shortening of trunk and limbs
Radiographic evidence of platyspondyly and epiphyseal dysplasia in vertebrae and long bones
Identification of pathogenic variants in COL2A1 gene specific to Omani type
Characteristic facial dysmorphism including midface hypoplasia and cleft palate
Progressive growth retardation noted in early childhood

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of severe disproportionate short stature with confirmatory radiological findings plus pathogenic COL2A1 variant
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is critical to differentiate from other spondyloepiphyseal dysplasias

pathognomonic.symptomName: Disproportionate short stature with trunk and limb shortening
Platyspondyly with epiphyseal dysplasia on radiographs
searchTerms: flattened spine bones with abnormal bone ends
vertebral and epiphyseal abnormalities on scans
compressed vertebrae with growth plate issues
flat face and split roof of mouth

common.symptomName: Hip joint dysplasia with limited range of motion

searchTerms: hearing loss from ear bone hardening

occasional.symptomName: Respiratory complications due to thoracic cage deformity
searchTerms: respiratory issues due to thorax shape
lung complications from chest wall abnormality
instability at skull base causing nerve problems
upper neck bone instability with neurological signs
dangerous joint movement at skull and spine
obstructive sleep apnea with heavy symptoms

imaging: Radiographs showing platyspondyly, epiphyseal dysplasia, and metaphyseal abnormalities
MRI for spinal cord assessment in cases of instability
genetic: Pathogenic variants in COL2A1 gene associated with Omani type SED
other: Clinical assessment of growth parameters and facial dysmorphism

distinguishingFeatures: Rhizomelic limb shortening rather than disproportionate trunk shortening
Characteristic facial features distinct from SED Omani type

redFlags: Progressive neurological deficits due to cervical spine instability
Severe respiratory compromise from thoracic deformity
Early-onset severe osteoarthritis causing functional impairment
references: Al-Gazali L et al. Spondyloepiphyseal Dysplasia, Omani Type: Clinical and Molecular Characterization. Am J Med Genet A. 2019.
